pages.text: Third dive. The Quantum Foam has a floor and a ceiling I cannot pass. Below lies $(item)Schrödinger's Limit$(), where every possibility is still undecided.

Above lies $(item)Relativity Breakdown$(), where spacetime stops being smooth - the scale where general relativity and quantum mechanics both fail at once.$(br2)Both are liquids that will not flow and cannot be crossed. Fill a cell from either and it is still there - they regenerate at once.

Schrödinger's Limit becomes the concepts of quantum mechanics in the $(item)Analytic Continuator$(): $(item)Wavefunctions$(), the $(item)Hamiltonian$(), $(item)Eigenstates$(), the $(item)Path Integral$().

Relativity Breakdown becomes $(item)Geodesics$(), $(item)Christoffel Symbols$() and the $(item)Stress-Energy Tensor$() in the $(item)Chrono Loom$(). The two great theories of the last century, bottled separately. Someday I must make them agree.

The Foam is alive:$(li)$(thing)Virtual Pairs$() drift harmlessly.$(li)$(thing)Vacuum Drifters$() only fight back; their sting is $(thing)Vacuum Decay$(): no healing.$(li)$(thing)Planck Mites$() hunt in packs; their bite $(thing)decoheres$() you.
Everything a particle could be, written down at once.$(br2)Made in $(item)Analytic Continuator$().
Every way of getting from here to there, added up.$(br2)Made in $(item)Analytic Continuator$().
How the coordinates twist from one point to the next.$(br2)Made in $(item)Chrono Loom$().
Matter tells spacetime how to curve. This is what it says.$(br2)Made in $(item)Chrono Loom$().

$(thing)Where these go$():$(li)$(item)Wavefunction$(): Feynman Diagram, Hamiltonian Operator, Quantum Singularity$(li)$(item)Path Integral$(): Theory of Everything$(li)$(item)Christoffel Symbol$(): Stress-Energy Tensor, Unified Notes II$(li)$(item)Stress-Energy Tensor$(): Spacetime Singularity, Unified Notes III
$(thing)Virtual Pair$(). Lives in: Quantum Foam.$(br)Drops: Virtual Photon, Virtual Quark.
$(thing)Vacuum Drifter$(). Lives in: Quantum Foam.$(br)Drops: False Vacuum Membrane, Virtual Graviton.
$(thing)Planck Mite$(). Lives in: Quantum Foam.$(br)Drops: Foam Substrate, Virtual Monopole.
